## Definitions intentionally without standalone durable carriers

| Definition | Classification | Realization |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cal.definition.actor@1.0.0-candidate.1` | `abstract-participation-class` | Represent each concrete participant through its governed carrier, then classify the exact revision through Classification Scheme, Classification Value, and Classification Assignment. |
| `cal.definition.agent@1.0.0-candidate.1` | `abstract-operational-actor-class` | Represent concrete operation through Agent Instance inside Agent Session, then classify the exact instance through the governed Agent actor-kind Scheme and Assignment. |
| `cal.definition.session-memory@1.0.0-candidate.1` | `ephemeral-runtime-value` | Closed Session Memory schema embedded in Agent Session runtime; persistence is forbidden and no durable Artifact Type instance is permitted. |
| `cal.definition.operational-learning-cycle@1.0.0-candidate.1` | `governed-method` | Represent the selected method through Governed Model or Workflow plus its concrete Lesson, Application, Assessment, and Improvement artifacts. |
| `cal.definition.classification@1.0.0-candidate.1` | `abstract-act-and-result` | Classification Scheme defines the contract; Classification Assignment records the governed result; Classification Value supplies allowed answers. |
| `cal.definition.failure@1.0.0-candidate.1` | `abstract-condition` | Failure Mode defines the possible boundary violation; Failure Occurrence records evidence of an episode; Failure Assessment evaluates it. |
